about_the_game: Ye Guild Clerk! is a 2.5D interactive fiction where you play as the Guild Clerk. Meet a cast of cute animal adventurers, each with their own stories, troubles, and personalities. As a guild clerk, you'll hand out quests, reward characters with gold, and distribute adventurer equipment. Through casual conversations from behind your desk, learn about their tales and personal lives. The quests, items, and gold you give to adventurers will shape their journey and your relationship with each character. Make friends or frenemies in the guild's lively community! Perfect for players who love character-driven stories, cute animals, and cozy fantasy worlds.

short_description: Ye Guild Clerk! is a casual, interactive fiction, medieval job sim where the player takes on the role of a guild clerk in a whimsy world full of cute animal adventurers! It's your job to navigate the clerk counter to hand out quests, equipment, and rewards to adventurers who come to the guild house!
